scientific_integrity: An explicit algebraic argument and independent exact cyclotomic finite tests support the universal theorem. Finite computations are not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact Fourier zero-set and convolution rank only for cubic three-coordinate moment curves and residue-dependent first-digit perturbations modulo prime squares; not full eigenvalues or general higher prime powers. Literature priority beyond the cited material is not independently certified.
title: Fourier-null rigidity of residue-deformed cubic moment curves over prime-square rings
